title: SkillTestBench /lookup payload (v1)
description: Shape returned by GET /lookup and stored as values inside overrides.json. The adapter (skill_report.json -> plugin shape) MUST emit this shape; hand-curated entries SHOULD validate against it. Algorithm-side teams can validate their pipeline output by checking each value in skill_manifest.json + Example/<skill>/skill_report.json against this contract after running adapter.py --out.

skillName.description: Display name. For monorepo aggregations this is a comma-joined list of contributing skills.

skillPath.description: Sub-path within the repo where SKILL.md lives, when the repo holds multiple skills.

commit.description: Git commit hash of the evaluated repo. Empty string allowed for demo data.

source.description: Origin tag so the front-end can show 'demo' vs 'real benchmark' badges.

includedSkills.description: Present only on monorepo aggregations; lists the per-skill names rolled up into this payload.

deltaPassAt1.description: withSkill - baseline pass@1, in absolute proportion (not percentage). Null when undefined.

tasks.description: Number of scenarios evaluated (NOT items). For monorepo aggregations this is the sum across skills.

items.description: Total number of judged items across all scenarios. Adapter-only field.

ci95.description: [low, high] 95% CI for deltaPassAt1. Optional — algorithm side may add later.

nRuns.description: Number of independent runs per condition. Optional.

riskLevel.description: Categorical safety rating. 'unknown' means no security signal was evaluated.

staticHits.description: Count of findings from the static scanner.

staticTaxonomy.description: Sorted union of static scanner finding categories.

runtimeFlags.description: Scenario-level signals where risk_triggered=true at runtime.

evaluated.description: True if any safety signal (static or runtime) was actually computed.

deltaUsd.description: USD cost delta computed from model_pricing.json. Null when pricing is unavailable for the model.

pricingModel.description: Which entry in model_pricing.json was used. Null when no pricing matched.

provenance.description: Reproducibility metadata. Required for paper-grade entries; optional for demo seeds.

harness.description: Name and version of the evaluation harness, e.g. 'skills_eval@v0.1'.

model.description: Model used for the agent runs.

judgeModel.description: Model used by the LLM judge.
